summary.text: Lindsay Powell is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 21 who has served since October 2, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Powell previously worked in workforce development and Pittsburgh city government.

paragraphs.text: Lindsay Powell earned a B.A. in sociology and political science from Wheaton College in 2013 and an M.S. in public policy from Carnegie Mellon University in 2017.

Her career experience includes working as director of workforce strategies at InnovatePGH, as an assistant chief of staff and policy analyst for the City of Pittsburgh, and as a legislative fellow in the office of U.S. Representative Hakeem Jeffries.
Powell assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on October 2, 2023.
